no primary ownership; contributing slice only

## Summary

GATE-G8's scoped authorization permits admission-dossier preparation only.
This ticket fills its owner-bound slot in the common seven-row §9.3
amendment register (`docs/build/planning/2026-10-30_amendment-dossier.md`):
**Packet C (PADR-R5-3∗)** — the native closure/profile proposal — an
additive, versioned `evidence-package/1`∗ typed member/role profile inside
`hh-bundle/1`, an owner-typed recipient-closure interface, immutable
attempt/grade/export coordinates and access/loss/procedure verdicts.
Nothing is admitted: no ADR number is allocated, no product source/schema/
generated file is touched, every proposed name is marked `∗` unadmitted.
GATE-G9 (seq 174) decides.

## Design decisions

- **Derived index, never authority:** `evidence-package/1`∗ lives inside
  `hh-bundle/1` owned by the bundle codec/validator; producers (ledger,
  experiment, bench/verification, budget, results, analysis/eval,
  identity/provenance) remain authoritative — the §9.3 row's rejected
  stand-alone receipt authority.
- **Owner-typed closure, no byte scanning:** `closure_walk∗` traverses
  through codec-enumerated payload refs (`producer_ref∗{domain, owner,
  ref, role}`); no hash regex, no second class table, and no
  hh-bundle→bench/results crate edge (dep manifest re-confirmed:
  `hharness-results` depends on bundle, never the reverse).
- **R0 fix rides beside, not inside:** the §9.3 "existing-contract fix"
  (R0 open/finished mapping, R-2.9.3) is already lifecycle-correct at
  `b07d0c5` (`bundle_ops.rs` lifecycle fold); design F5's
  "terminal payload status" note was stale — drift recorded, semantics
  adopted as observed.
- **Legacy untouched:** every `hh-live-evidence/1` byte and ADR-0363
  meaning preserved; `run_ledger_head` labelled build-note snapshot —
  never a native WAL head; unknown required versions refuse while legacy
  stays inspectable.
